about.title: About Us
about.storyText: Neri Shoes was founded with years of experience and passion to create footwear that makes a difference with every step. By combining a modern design approach with traditional craftsmanship, we offer both comfort and elegance together. Our brand aims to deliver a premium experience accessible to everyone, without compromising on quality.
about.valueQualityText: We apply the highest quality standards to every product.
about.valueTrustText: We build long-lasting trust relationships with our customers.
about.valueStyleText: We make a difference with timeless and modern designs.
about.heroSubtitle: Every model a story. Every stitch a signature.
about.whoText: Neri Shoes brings together Adana's deep-rooted manufacturing culture with modern footwear design. Since its founding, the brand has operated as a manufacturer, retailer and wholesaler in the footwear industry. From design to production, wholesale to retail — we pursue the highest standards at every step.
about.craftText: At Neri Shoes, our vision is to deliver both style and foot health. We choose premium materials — genuine leather, suede, nubuck and floater leather — and use the latest sole technologies such as EVA, rubber, air sole and orthopedic gel systems for superior comfort.
about.icon2: EVA Sole / Orthopedic Gel / Air Sole
about.missionText: To deliver 100% genuine leather craftsmanship and ultra-light EVA sole comfort to every step — staying clear of synthetic and artificial materials — and to elevate walking quality in modern urban life.
about.visionText: To become Turkey's and the region's largest, most trusted wholesale footwear supplier and leading brand, by combining our deep-rooted craft culture with modern production technologies. To offer wholesale partners market leadership with innovative collections every season.
about.directTitle: Directly From Production to the Consumer
about.directText: The collections crafted in our modern production facility in Adana Seyhan reach the world through our wholesale network, and directly to you through our retail stores and online sales channels.
